ruleOrigin: Own experimental requirements, not external UX evidence; no numerical option-count threshold or production eligibility rule is asserted.

cases.title: Eignung mit vollständigen Fakten
cases.experimentalRule: Experimental rule recommends considering Autocomplete when both stated facts are true.
cases.expectedResearchObservation: Recommendation plus rule ID, not obligation or automatic final selection.

cases.title: Bekannter Ausschluss
cases.experimentalRule: The experimental existing-entry-only candidate is unsuitable for a requirement to accept novel entries.
cases.expectedResearchObservation: Explicit unsuitable outcome, linked to the exclusion rule; no changed component behavior.

cases.title: Fehlende Voraussetzung
cases.expectedResearchObservation: Unknown fact reported; no silent unsuitable/suitable default.

cases.title: false und null unterscheiden
cases.experimentalRule: Same condition evaluated with each of the three distinct inputs.
cases.expectedResearchObservation: Input distinctions preserved or framework limitation/own mapping explicitly documented.

cases.title: Pflicht und Empfehlung
cases.experimentalRule: A recommendation must not silently relax the mandatory experimental prerequisite.
cases.expectedResearchObservation: Separate normative levels and explicit provenance of any added priority policy.

cases.title: Widerspruch und Ausnahme
cases.experimentalRule: Opposite experimental rules target the same component; second variant adds an explicit scoped exception.
cases.expectedResearchObservation: Conflict reported or resolved by a declared policy; exception distinguishable from arbitrary rule order.

cases.title: Referenz auf Originaldomänen
cases.experimentalRule: An experimental UX rule points to existing CEM, token/CSS, SCXML and accessibility anchors.
cases.expectedResearchObservation: All targets typed and revision-bound; no duplicated leading behavior or values.

cases.title: Zwei Bibliotheken
cases.experimentalRule: Same component ID occurs in two isolated temporary fixture libraries.
cases.expectedResearchObservation: Rule never applies to the other library merely because names match.

cases.title: Veraltete Revision

inputSketch.mutation: alter a referenced file in a temporary copy

cases.experimentalRule: Rule remains bound to the pre-mutation hash.
cases.expectedResearchObservation: Explicit stale binding; no automatic latest fallback.

cases.title: Fehlender oder falscher Anker
cases.experimentalRule: Known library and component but invalid detailed anchor.
cases.expectedResearchObservation: Explicit binding error; file existence alone is insufficient.

cases.title: Gemeinsame und lokale Regeln
cases.experimentalRule: Reuse one rule by reference and add a scoped local exception.
cases.expectedResearchObservation: No duplicated rule body; applicability/exception policy explicit; unrelated components unaffected.

cases.title: Gezieltes Nachladen und Belege
cases.experimentalRule: Retrieve only relevant rules, cited rationale and required dependencies.
cases.expectedResearchObservation: List actual files/bytes and missing evidence; no claim of measured model context or agent success without a separate model run.
